metadata.summary: If there is one position that highlights the growth of the women's game in England, it is the competition for the half-back spot at the Rugby League World Cup.
metadata.content: Rugby League World Cup: England Women's half-back dilemma as Jenna Foubister, Izzy Rowe and Georgia Roche head into competition in form | Rugby League News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Rugby League World Cup: England Women's half-back dilemma as Jenna Foubister, Izzy Rowe and Georgia Roche head into competition in form England Women have three outstanding half-back options for the upcoming Rugby League World Cup, with Jenna Foubister, Izzy Rowe and Georgia Roche all vying for a place in the side; their campaign gets under way against Wales on October 17 with Izzy Rowe and Georgia Roche starting Megan Wellens Sports Journalist @MegWellensX Wednesday 14 October 2026 06:51, UK Image: Georgia Roche, Jenna Foubister and Izzy Rowe - credit SWpix If there is one position that highlights the growth of the women's game in England, it is the competition for the half-back spot at the Rugby League World Cup. Two Wigan stars provide one option, with Woman of Steel Jenna Foubister joined by her best friend and Warriors half-back partner Izzy Rowe. Then there's NRLW star and former Woman of Steel Georgia Roche, who has been tearing it up on the other side of the world. It is a selection headache that England Women head coach Stuart Barrow welcomes as he prepares his side for three pool games, with a place in the semi-finals at stake.
